description: I enjoy exploring challenging ideas and building innovative solutions using technology. I'm looking to connect with curious, motivated, and collaborative people who are excited about learning, experimenting, and creating something meaningful for Challenge. I'm particularly interested in teammates with skills in Python, AIML, GIS and Remote Sensing, Web Development, UI/UX, and Data Visualization. You don't need to be an expert creativity, problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn matter.
